notes:
Zone (verified in the model). First-floor plan, balcony/cafeteria calibration (X = −18.8 + px·0.029984, Y = 7.83 − (py−187)·0.030273); ray casts, sections and height maps of the GLB (scripts/probe_upper.py, survey_upper.png). The plan's cells east of Founder Space 2 (110, 323, 21, 62, 349 sq ft) do not exist in the model. Doors: Cafeteria X 3.90, Y 1.95..3.55; Meeting Podium X 5.25..6.45. The east stair arrives at X 15.10, Y 1.62..2.53.

Photos. 116–126, 129, 131, 132, 135, 136 plus 115, 121 and 123 from the “upper floor” folder. 102 was taken from the ground floor (Founder Space 1) looking up, so it is not used as a viewpoint. People in the photos are ignored.

Built as new objects. 500 mm glazed floor tiles; mint walls with the yellow sun mural (rays, circuit traces) round the Cafeteria door; black-and-white swirl stripes on the east wall; 600 mm lay-in ceiling with LED panels; a crinkled dark foil coffer over the void with a white edge; the blue wire “net globe” with yellow balls, hung on cables; steel railings with wood handrails and dark grey fascia panels round the void and the stair well; a clock on the fascia; 34 desk places (mahogany desks, black or maroon executive chairs, monitors or an iMac, towers, keyboards) as collection instances; roll-up banners (KII-IMPACT, SafeBangle, i-define hub, Sleek, EXPLORE, SUMIC IT); grey fabric stands; a green birdhouse box; a whiteboard on an easel; potted plants; sheer curtains; the Meeting Podium door and sign.

Differences from the photos. (1) The real void is larger and the ceiling over it is a deep sloped coffer; the model's void is 2.8 × 3.6 m and its ceiling is flat at 2.51 m, so the coffer is a flat foil panel and the sculpture is smaller. (2) The real room holds more desks; seats that did not fit with at least 0.75 m aisles were dropped (no shrinking). (3) The model has no columns upstairs.
